surfaces_and_micro_themes.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-20 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/10 flex justify-around items-center px-4 pb-safe max-w-md mx-auto z-50
surfaces_and_micro_themes.glass_header: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
surfaces_and_micro_themes.metro_card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-[#1A1A1C] border border-white/10 shadow-lg p-6

animation_and_interactions.card_entrance: framer-motion initial={{opacity: 0, y: 20}} animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}} transition={{duration: 0.4}}

home_greeting_bg.description: Kolkata night cityscape for top header/greeting section behind the weather/date.

virtual_card_bg.description: Abstract blue light streaks for the Virtual Metro Card background overlay.

qr_code_abstract.description: Abstract digital squares for ticket QR screen background.

components_instructions.name: BottomNavigation
components_instructions.instructions: Use fixed position at bottom. 4-5 items: Home, Map, Tickets, Profile. Use Phosphor Icons. Active state uses Orange (#FF8C00) and an active indicator dot.

components_instructions.name: RouteFinder
components_instructions.instructions: Vertical timeline design. Two main inputs for Source and Destination. Swap button between them. Display connecting stations with Line Color indicator dots (Blue, Green, Purple, Orange).

components_instructions.name: VirtualMetroCard
components_instructions.instructions: A credit-card proportioned div. Background image `virtual_card_bg` with black/60 overlay. Add a 'Tap to Pay (NFC)' pulsing area. Display current balance prominently.

components_instructions.name: StationDetailsBottomSheet
components_instructions.instructions: Use a bottom sheet pattern (framer-motion slide up) for showing station details, facilities (escalator, parking), and upcoming trains.

components_instructions.name: AIChatbot
components_instructions.instructions: Floating Action Button above the bottom nav or a dedicated tab. Chat interface with dark bubbles. AI messages have subtle gradient border. Include suggested prompts like 'First train from Dum Dum?'

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid in kebab-case, e.g., data-testid='swap-stations-button', data-testid='buy-ticket-cta'
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over gradients has text-shadow or a dark overlay underneath. Secondary text must be Zinc-400 or lighter for APCA/WCAG AA compliance.
